x.author: mrcashcollector
x.body:
if i had to book 10 calls for a b2b agency from linkedin in the next 30 days, i'd take these 24 steps, in this order...

1) write down who you help in one sentence
2) use verified linkedin accounts to send inmails
3) build the company list in sales navigator first
4) cut competitors, clients, freelancers and the wrong size
5) give every company a dated reason to talk
6) find the person who decides, not the one who influences
7) keep only people who posted in the last 30 days
8) check every name

If you're about to spend money on YouTube automation, read this first.

YouTube automation isn’t a business model. It’s a way of operating a YouTube business.

This is one thing I wish more beginners understood before spending money on tools, freelancers and AI subscriptions.

Automation tells you how the work gets done.

You can automate research, use AI to help with scripts, hire an editor, outsource thumbnails and create a workflow for publishing.

But none of that answers the most important
